source_text:
Title: I love sweet potatoes and eggs in the morning, so when I saw @eatswithjamie’s viral sweet potato omelette, I had to try it, and I loved it so much! This recipe feeds 2 people, but you can easily cut it in half or double it for a family. 🍳

INGREDIENTS
1 small sweet potato, peeled
1 teaspoon olive oil
4 large eggs
2 tablespoons milk
¼ teaspoon salt
⅛ teaspoon black pepper
¼ teaspoon garlic powder
¼ cup finely grated Parmesan cheese
INSTRUCTIONS
1. Using a vegetable peeler, peel the sweet potato lengthwise into thin ribbons.
2. Heat the olive oil in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat. Arrange the sweet potato ribbons in an even layer, overlapping them slightly to cover the bottom of the skillet. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, or until they begin to soften and lightly brown.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
4. Pour the egg mixture evenly over the sweet potato ribbons. Reduce the heat to medium-low, cover, and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, or until the eggs are mostly set.
5. Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese over the top. Cover again and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, or until the cheese melts and the eggs are completely set.
6. Slide the omelette onto a plate and serve warm.
